verses: Alif Laam Ra! yeh aali shaan kitab hum ney aap ki taraf utari hai kay aap logon ko andheron say ujalay ki taraf layen, unn kay perwerdigar kay hukum say, zabardast aur tareefon walay Allah ki taraf
Jiss Allah ka hai jo kuch aasmano aur zamin mein hai. Aur kafiron kay liye to sakht azab ki kharabi hai
Jo aakhirat kay muqablay mein dunyawi zindagi ko pasand rakhtay hain aur Allah ki raah say roktay hain aur uss mein terh pann peda kerna chahatay hain. Yehi log parli darjay ki gumrahi mein hain

Hum ney her her nabi ko uss ki qomi zaban mein hi bheja hai takay unn kay samney wazahat say biyan ker dey. Abb Allah jissay chahaye gumrah ker dey, aur jissay chahaye raah dikha dey, woh ghalba aur hikmat wala hai

(yaad rakho jab kay) hum ney Musa ko apni nishaniyan dey ker bheja kay to apni qom ko andheron say roshni mein nikal aur unhen Allah kay ehsanaat yaad dila. Uss mein nishaniyan hain her aik sabar shukar kerney walay kay liye

Jiss waqt Musa ney apni qom say kaha kay Allah kay woh ehsanaat yaad kero jo uss ney tum per kiye hain, jabkay uss ney tumhen firaoniyon say nijat di jo tumhen baray dukh phonchatay thay. Tumharay larkon ko qatal kertay thay aur tumhari larkiyon ko zindah chortay thay, uss mein tumharay rab ki taraf say tum per boht bari aazmaeesh thi
Aur jab tumharay perwerdigar ney tumhen aagah ker diya kay agar tum shukar guzari kero gay to be-shak mein tumhen ziyadah doon ga aur agar tum na-shukri kero gay to yaqeenan mera azab boht sakht hai
Musa (alaihi as-salam) ney kaha kay agar tum sab aur aur zamin kay tamam insan Allah ki na-shukri keren to bhi Allah bey niaz aur tareefon wala hai

Kiya tumharay pass tum say pehlay kay logon ki khabren nahi aayen? Yani qom Nooh ki aur aad o samood ki aur unn kay baad walon ki jinhen siwaye Allah Taalaa kay aur koi nahi janta, unn kay pass unn kay rasool moajzzay laye, lekin unhon ney apney hath apney mun mein daba aur saaf keh diya kay jo kuch tumhen dey ker bheja gaya hai hum uss kay munkir hain aur jiss cheez ki taraf tum humen bula rahey ho humen to uss mein bara bhari shuba)yeh hai

Unn kay rasoolon ney unhen kaha kay kiya haq Taalaa kay baray mein tumhen shak hai jo aasmano aur zamin ka bananey wala hai woh to tumhen uss liye bula raha hai kay tumharay gunah moaf farma dey, aur aik muqarrar waqt tak tumhen mohlat ata farmaye, unhon ney kaha kay tum to hum jaisay hi insan ho tum chahatay ho kay humen unn khudaon ki ibadat say rok do jin ki ibadat humaray baap dada kertay rahey. Acha to humaray samney koi khulli daleel paish kero

Unn kay payghumbaron ney unn say kaha kay yeh to sach hai kay hum tum jaisay hi insan hain lekin Allah Taalaa apney bandon mein say jiss per chahata hai apna fazal kerta hai. Allah kay hukum kay baghair humari majal nahi kay hum koi moajza tumhen laa dikhayen aur eman walon ko sirf Allah Taalaa hi per bharosa rakhna chahaiye

Aakhir kiya wajah hai kay hum Allah Taalaa per bharosa na rakhen jabkay ussi ney humen humari raahen sujhaee hain. O Allah jo ezayen tum humen do gay hum unn per sabar hi keren gay. Tawakkal kerney walon ko yehi laeeq hai kay Allah hi per tawakkal keren

Kafiron ney apney rasoolon say kaha kay hum tumhen mulk badar ker den gay ya tum phir say humaray mazhab mein lot aao. To unn kay perwerdigar ney unn ki taraf wahee bheji kay hum unn zalimon ko hi ghaarat ker den gay
Aur unn kay baad hum khud tumhen uss zamin mein basayen gay. Yeh hai unn kay liye jo meray samney kharay honey ka darr rakhen aur meri waeed say khofzada rahen
Aur unhon ney faisla talab kiya aur tamam sirkash ziddi log murad hogaye
Uss kay samney dozakh hai jahan woh peep ka pani pilaya jaye ga
Jissay mushkil ghoont ghoont piye ga. Phir bhi ussay galay say utaar na sakay ga aur ussay her jagah say maut aati dikhaee dey gi lekin woh marney wala nahi. Phir uss kay peechay bhi sakht azab hai

Unn logon ki misal jinhon ney apney paalney walay say kufur kiya, unn kay aemaal misil uss raakh kay hain jiss per tez hua aandhi walay din chalay. Jo bhi unhon ney kiya uss mein say kissi cheez per qadir na hun gay, yehi door ki gumrahi hai
Kiya tu ney nahi dekha kay Allah Taalaa ney aasmano ko aur zamin ko behtareen tadbeer kay sath peda kiya hai. Agar woh chahaye to tum sab ko fana kerdey aur naee makhlooq laye
Allah per yeh kaam kuch bhi mushkil nahi

Sab kay sab Allah kay samney roo-baroo kharay hun gay. Uss waqt kamzor log baraee walon say kahen gay kay hum to tumharay tabeydaar thay, to kiya tum Allah kay azabon mein say kuch azab hum say door sakney walay ho? Woh jawab den gay kay agar Allah humen hidayat deta to hum bhi zaroor tumhari rehnumaee kertay, abb to hum per bey qarari kerna aur sabar kerna dono hi barabar hai humaray liye koi chutkara nahi

Jab aur kaam ka faisla kerdiya jaye ga to shetan kahey ga kay Allah ney to tumhen sacha wada diya tha aur mein ney tum say jo waday kiye thay unn kay khilaf kiya, mera tum per koi dabao to tha hi nahi, haan mein ney tumhen pukara aur tum ney meri maan li, pus tum mujhay ilzam na lagao balkay)yeh khud apney aap ko malamat kero, na mein tumhara faryad rass aur na tum meri faryad ko phonchney walay, mein to siray say manta hi nahi kay tum mujhay uss say pehlay Allah ka shareek mantay rahey, yaqeenan zalimon kay liye dard-naak azab hai

Jo log eman laye aur nek amal kiye woh unn jannaton mein dakhil kiye jayen gay jin kay neechay chashmay jari hain jahan unhen hameshgi hogi apney rab kay hukum say. Jahan unn ka khair muqaddam salam say hoga
Kiya aap ney nahi dekha kay Allah Taalaa ney pakeezah baat ki misal kiss tarah biyan farmaee, misil aik pakeezah darakht kay jiss ki jarr mazboot hai aur jiss ki tehniyan aasman mein hain
Jo apney perwerdigar kay hukum say her waqt apney phal laata hai, aur Allah Taalaa logon kay samney misalen biyan farmata hai takay woh naseehat hasil keren
Aur pak baat ki misal ganday darakht jaisi hai jo zamin kay kuch hi upper say ukhar liya gaya. Ussay kuch sabaat to hai nahi
Eman walon ko Allah Taalaa pakki baat kay sath mazboot rakhta hai, duniya ki zindagi mein bhi aur aakhirat mein bhi, haan insaf logon ko Allah behka deta hai aur Allah jo chahaye ker guzray
Kiya aap ney unn ki taraf nazar nahi daali jinhon ney Allah ki nemat kay badlay na-shukri ki aur apni qom ko halakat kay ghar mein laa utara
Yani dozakh mein jiss mein yeh sab jayen gay, jo bad-tareen thikana hai
Unhon ney Allah kay humsar bana kay logon ko Allah ki raah say behkayen. Aap keh dijiye kay khair mazay kerlo tumhari gasht to aakhir jahannum hi hai

Meray eman walay bandon say keh dijiye kay namazon ko qaeem rakhen aur jo kuch hum ney unhen dey rakha hai uss mein say kuch na kuch posheedah aur zahir kharach kertay rahen uss say pehlay kay woh din aajaye jiss mein na khareed khareed-o-farokht hogi na dosti aur mohabbat

Allah woh hai jiss ney aasmano aur zamin ko peda kiya hai aur aasmano say barish barsa ker uss kay zariye say tumhari rozi kay liye phal nikalay hain aur kashtiyon ko tumharay bus mein kerdiya hai kay daryaon mein uss kay hukum say chalen phiren. Ussi ney nadiyan aur nehren tumharay ikhtiyar mein kerdi hain
Ussi ney tumharay liye sooraj chand ko musakhar kerdiya hai kay barabar hi chal rahey hain aur raat din ko bhi tumharay kaam mein laga rakha hai
Ussi ney tumhen tumhari mun maangi kul cheezon mein say dey rakha hai. Agar tum Allah kay ehsan ginna chahao to unhen pooray ginn bhi nahi saktay. Yaqeenan insan bara hi bey insaf aur nashukra hai
(Ibrahim ki yeh dua bhi yaad kero) jab unhon ney kaha kay aey meray perwerdigar! uss shehar ko aman wala bana, aur mujhay aur meri aulad ko butt parasti say panah dey.

Aey meray paalney walay mabood! unhon ney boht say logon ko raah say bhatka diya hai. Pus meri tabeydaari kerney wala mera hai aur jo meri na-farmani keray to to boht hi moaf aur karam kerney wala hai.

Aey humaray perwerdigar! mein ney apni kuch aulad uss bey kheti ki wadi mein teray hurmat walay ghar kay pass basaee hai. Aey humaray perwerdigar! yeh uss liye kay woh namaz qaeem rakhen, pus to kuch logon kay dilon ko unn ki taraf maeel kerdey. Aur unhen phalon ki roziyan inayat farma takay yeh shukar guzari keren
Aey humaray perwerdigar! to khoob janta hai jo hum chupayen aur jo zahir keren. Zamin o aasman ki koi cheez Allah per posheedah nahi
Allah ka shukar hai jiss ney mujhay uss burhapay mein Ismail o Ishaq (alaihima as-salam) ata farmaye. Kuch shak nahi kay mera palanhaar Allah duaon ka sunnay wala hai
Aey meray paalney walay! mujhay namaz ka paband rakh aur meri aulad say bhi, aey humaray rab meri dua qabool farma
Aey humaray perwerdigar! mujhay bakhsh dey aur meray maa baap ko bhi bakhsh aur deegar mominon ko bhi bakhsh jiss din hisab honey lagay
Insafon kay aemaal say Allah ko ghafil na samajh woh to unhen uss din tak mohlat diye huye hai jiss din aankhen phati ki phati reh jayen gi
Woh apney sir upper uthaye dor bhaag ker rahey hun gay, khud apni taraf bhi unn ki nigahen na loten gi aur unn kay dil khali aur aray huye hun gay

Logon ko uss din say hoshiyaar kerdey jab kay unn kay pass azab aajaye ga, aur zalim kahen gay kay aey humaray rab humen boht thoray qareeb kay waqt tak ki hi mohlat dey kay hum teri tableegh maan len aur teray payghumbaron ki tabeydaari mein lag jayen. Kiya tum uss say pehlay bhi qasmen nahi kha rahey thay? Kay tumharay liye duniya say talna hi nahi

Aur kiya tum unn logon kay gharon mein rehtay sehtay na thay jinhon ney apni janon per zulm kiya aur kiya tum per woh moamla khulla nahi kay hum ney unn kay sath kaisa kuch kiya. Hum ney to (tumharay samjhaney ko) boht si misalen biyan kerdi thin
Yeh apni apni chalen chal rahey hain aur Allah ko unn ki tamam chaalon ka ilm hai aur unn ki chalen aisi na thin kay unn say pahar apni jagah say tal jayen
Aap hergiz yeh khayal na keren kay Allah apney nabiyon say wada khilafi keray ga, Allah bara hi ghalib aur badla lenay wala hai
Jiss din zamin uss zamin kay siwa aur hi badal di jaye gi aur aasman bhi, aur sab kay sab Allah wahid ghalbay walay kay roo-baroo hun gay
Aap uss din gunah gaaron ko dekhen gay kay zanjeeron mein milay julay aik jagah jakray huye hun gay
Unn kay libas gandhak kay hun gay aur aag unn kay chehron per bhi charhi hui hogi
Yeh uss liye kay Allah Taalaa her shakhs ko uss kay kiye huye aemaal ka badla dey, be-shak Allah Taalaa ko hisab letay kuch dare nahi lagney ki
Yeh Quran tamam logon kay liye itlaa nama hai kay uss kay zariye say woh hoshiyaar ker diye jayen aur bakhoobi maloom kerlen kay Allah aik hi mabood hai aur takay aqalmand log soch samajh len
